text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. 1 Make a joyful noise to the LORD {YHWH}, all the earth.
Serve the LORD {YHWH} with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
Know that the LORD {YHWH} is God {Elohim}. It is He who made us, and we are His (and not we ourselves); we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
For the LORD {YHWH} is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
